subject: Post-demo security asks — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@healthwise.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 May 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security asks — SOC 2 Type II, bridge letter & portal access

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Quick recap and the asks we agreed to surface to your procurement/security teams: 

1) SOC 2 evidence: HealthWise requested Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report (covering Jan–Dec 2027) and a short bridge letter if the full report cannot be shared yet.
2) Temporary attestation: you asked whether we can provide an interim attestation while the Type II package is being coordinated.
3) Vendor security questionnaire (DDQ): happy to start the standard DDQ — please tell us whether you prefer the DocuSign route or a shared spreadsheet.
4) Trust portal access: we can provision a trust portal bucket (read-only) for artifact transfer. We'll need the primary POC email for portal invite and whether you'd like SSO (SAML) auto-provisioning.

Next steps from our side: Ben will confirm the packaging for the SOC2 deliverable and Connor will start the portal provisioning once we have the POC and required domain info. From you: please confirm the procurement contact and any specific required artifacts beyond the Type II and bridge letter (e.g., data retention policy, encryption attestations).

Attachments: postcall-deck.pdf (light summary of security/hosting controls).

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Ben confirms the package and Connor has the portal plan.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks Marissa — that recap is perfect. Procurement looped in. A couple of clarifications before we kick off: 

- Preferred transfer: we usually get artifacts via a vendor trust portal or an S3 bucket with presigned links. Portal is preferred.
- Required artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report + bridge letter (if needed), DDQ (we can attach our questionnaire in DocuSign), and a copy of your Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and encryption-at-rest statement.
- Timeline: procurement is aiming to complete vendor due diligence by 31 May 2028. Is that feasible?

Procurement, meet Marissa (AE) and Ben (security lead at Redwood). Procurement — would you prefer DocuSign for the DDQ or an emailed spreadsheet?

Best,
Alice

Thanks — I’ll push the report bundle once Connor confirms how we deliver.
